codes.name: lexical_error
codes.summary: Unexpected character, unknown string escape, or unterminated string literal.
codes.fix: Check the highlighted characters and close every string on the same line.

codes.name: integer_literal_overflow
codes.summary: Integer literal does not fit in signed 64-bit int.
codes.fix: Use a smaller literal; the maximum is 9223372036854775807.

codes.name: syntax_error
codes.summary: The parser found a token it did not expect.
codes.fix: Compare the highlighted line with docs/GRAMMAR.ebnf; look for a missing brace, colon, or comma.

codes.name: expected_expression
codes.summary: An expression was required at this position.
codes.fix: Write a literal, variable, call, or parenthesized expression.

codes.name: if_expression_missing_else
codes.summary: An if expression used as a value must have an else branch.
codes.fix: Add an else branch or use the statement form.

codes.name: duplicate_definition
codes.summary: Two functions share a name, or a function is named print (built-in).
codes.fix: Remove or rename one of the definitions.

codes.name: missing_main
codes.summary: No main function or top-level executable statements were found.
codes.fix: Add fn main() { ... } or a top-level statement.

codes.name: type_mismatch
codes.summary: An initializer, assignment, argument, return value, or comparison has incompatible types. Only int-to-float widens implicitly.
codes.fix: Correct the types; use a compatible value.

codes.name: cannot_infer_type
codes.summary: A type could not be inferred, or inference produced conflicting types.
codes.fix: Add a type annotation or make call sites and return values consistent.

codes.name: missing_return
codes.summary: A value-returning function does not end with a return value.
codes.fix: Add a return expression as the last statement.

codes.name: unknown_type
codes.summary: A type annotation is not a supported built-in type.
codes.fix: Use int, float, bool, str, unit, or native-GUI-only window/widget handles.

codes.name: unknown_variable
codes.summary: The variable is not defined in an enclosing scope.
codes.fix: Define it before use or correct its spelling.

codes.name: unknown_function
codes.summary: No function with this name exists.
codes.fix: Check the spelling or define the function.

codes.name: argument_count_mismatch
codes.summary: A call passes a different number of arguments than required, or main has parameters.
codes.fix: Match the call to the function signature.

codes.name: assignment_to_immutable
codes.summary: The variable was declared immutable.
codes.fix: Declare it with let mut if reassignment is needed.

codes.name: condition_must_be_bool
codes.summary: if and while conditions require bool values.
codes.fix: Write an explicit boolean comparison.

codes.name: invalid_operands
codes.summary: The operator or operation is not defined for these operand types.
codes.fix: Use supported operand types as described in docs/LANGUAGE_SPEC.md.

codes.name: duplicate_binding
codes.summary: Two let bindings have the same name in one scope.
codes.fix: Rename one variable or remove the earlier binding.

codes.name: break_outside_loop
codes.summary: break was used outside a loop.
codes.fix: Move break inside a while or for loop.

codes.name: continue_outside_loop
codes.summary: continue was used outside a loop.
codes.fix: Move continue inside a while or for loop.

codes.name: return_outside_function
codes.summary: return was used in top-level executable code.
codes.fix: Move return into a function.

codes.name: unknown_method
codes.summary: A method is not supported for this receiver type.
codes.fix: Use a documented list, string, or map method.

codes.name: map_literal_too_large
codes.summary: A map literal may have at most 127 key/value entries.
codes.fix: Split the literal or build the map incrementally.

codes.name: invalid_bytecode_file
codes.summary: Bad magic, unsupported format version, invalid UTF-8, or a malformed bytecode container.
codes.fix: Rebuild the bytecode from source with Lutetium.

codes.name: bytecode_verification_failed
codes.summary: Bytecode failed structural or control-flow verification.
codes.fix: Recompile the source; hand-written bytecode must conform to docs/BYTECODE_FORMAT.md.

codes.name: truncated_bytecode
codes.summary: The bytecode file ends inside a value or instruction.
codes.fix: Rebuild the module from source.

codes.name: call_stack_overflow
codes.summary: Recursion exceeded the VM call-depth limit.
codes.fix: Reduce recursion depth or use iteration.

codes.name: integer_division_by_zero
codes.summary: The divisor of integer / or % was zero.
codes.fix: Check the divisor before dividing.

codes.name: corrupted_bytecode_runtime
codes.summary: The VM encountered invalid bytecode during execution; verified compiler output should not trigger this.
codes.fix: Rebuild from source and report reproducible compiler output.

codes.name: runtime_type_error
codes.summary: An instruction received a value of an unexpected type or an uninitialized register.
codes.fix: Report the issue if it is triggered by type-checked source.

codes.name: integer_overflow
codes.summary: An integer arithmetic operation exceeded the signed 64-bit range.
codes.fix: Use smaller operands or float values where appropriate.

codes.name: builtin_operation_failed
codes.summary: A built-in runtime operation failed, such as indexing, map lookup, or filesystem I/O.
codes.fix: Check the runtime message, indices, keys, and filesystem permissions.

codes.name: native_compilation_unsupported
codes.summary: The program uses a feature unsupported by the experimental native backend.
codes.fix: Run with the bytecode VM or restrict native code to supported scalar operations.

codes.name: native_linking_failed
codes.summary: The generated Windows GNU native executable could not be linked.
codes.fix: Check the pinned x86_64-pc-windows-gnu target and bundled MinGW components.
